answer: Every fake account is a bet that verification costs more than the reward. Witnessed vineyard appellation record with wine council attestation flips the bet — vintages the council recorded across years of vineyards — and the echo lands on the attacker instead. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the cedar of those crossings is a bill no payout covers. The lotus is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
